word_layout: item-major, lane-minor, little-endian 32-bit words on the card (item k, lane j at word k*LANES + j); results in arrival order

registers.8: MAX_OUT: pacing for designs that hold ONE item at a time -- at most this many results outstanding (0 = unlimited)

spi: mode 0, MSB first, SCLK slower than clk/16 (27 MHz -> <= 1.6 MHz). 0x01 WR_REG addr d3..d0 | 0x02 RD_REG addr pad then 4 bytes | 0x03 WR_WORDS hi lo words | 0x04 RD_WORDS hi lo pad words
